name: ConfirmButton
purpose: Button that asks for a second press before it acts, inline, because the Settings window has no dialog layer.
base: none (a Button with a two-step state)

values.when: Destructive action (reset all settings); tone assumed from the decision.

props.name: label
props.description: Idle label, for example Reset all settings…

states: confirming (after first click; from source only)
keyboard: Enter or Space: the first press shows confirming; the second press runs onConfirm. Cancel key not recorded.
platform: Desktop Settings. Web and desktop should share Dialog kind confirm for destructive confirmations (open).
open: B lists the reset button under notWidgets as a shared Button with a danger tone and a two-step confirm. Kept here as ConfirmButton because the inline two-step is a behaviour users feel (A). Decision: confirmations are windows on desktop, so ConfirmButton may be replaced by Dialog kind confirm (undecided). Confirming state is from source only. The 28px height is from the catalogue.
